framings.text: The team needs a shared, trusted understanding of what matters this week, despite changing priorities.

outcome: Everyone understands the current priorities and can see how their work relates to them, without feeling monitored.

questions.text: What visibility would help people understand current priorities without feeling like surveillance?

alternatives.label: Conditional candidate: make weekly priorities explicit and revisit them as they change
alternatives.benefit: Could give the team a stable shared reference while accommodating change.
alternatives.cost: Requires timely decisions and consistent upkeep.
alternatives.undo_cost: Provisional; reverting would be simple, but confusion may return.

alternatives.label: Conditional candidate: use a lightweight team check-in focused only on priority changes
alternatives.benefit: Could keep attention on what matters without requiring broad status reporting.
alternatives.cost: May miss useful context and still consume shared time.
alternatives.undo_cost: Provisional; the format could be discontinued, though habits may persist.
